# Workshop Materials
## If using posit.cloud

.small[
- Log in to your [posit.cloud](https://posit.cloud/) account
- *Share posit.cloud email with Stacy*
- You'll be added to the space "Applied Regression Workshop"
- In the space...
  - Click blue "New Project" bubble
  - Choose "+ New Project From Template"
  - Choose the template **arm-workshop-materials**
  ]
  
---
